# Chauffeur Emil Lanka Tours
> Private chauffeur-guided tours across Sri Lanka with Emil Jayasekara

## About

Chauffeur Emil Lanka Tours is a private tour operator based in Sri Lanka, run by Emil Jayasekara — a SLTDA-certified senior chauffeur guide with 14+ years of experience guiding international travellers across the island. Emil speaks fluent English and is a certified wildlife tracker.

- Website: https://www.chauffeuremillankatour.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +94 76 191 7039
- Email: emiljayasekara5@gmail.com
- TripAdvisor: 5-star rated, 300+ reviews
- Certification: SLTDA Licensed (Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority)
- All tours are 100% private — no shared groups, ever

## What We Offer

Emil designs and personally leads every tour. Services include:

- Private chauffeur-guided sightseeing tours
- Wildlife safaris (Yala, Wilpattu, Udawalawe, Minneriya)
- Cultural heritage tours (Sigiriya, Polonnaruwa, Anuradhapura, Dambulla)
- Hill country and tea plantation tours (Ella, Nuwara Eliya, Kandy)
- Beach holidays (Mirissa, Galle, Trincomalee, Arugam Bay)
- Custom tailor-made itineraries for any duration
- Airport transfers and day trips
- Accommodation booking across all budgets (guesthouses to luxury lodges)

## Tour Packages

### 1. Wild Sri Lanka Safari — 7 Days / 6 Nights
Wildlife-focused tour covering Sinharaja Rainforest, Yala National Park, Udawalawe Elephant Reserve, and Wilpattu National Park. Includes leopard safaris, elephant watching, birding, and nature walks.
URL: https://www.chauffeuremillankatour.com/tours/wildlife-safari-7-days

### 2. Cultural Triangle Explorer — 5 Days / 4 Nights
Covers Sri Lanka's UNESCO World Heritage Cultural Triangle: Dambulla Cave Temple, Sigiriya Rock Fortress, Polonnaruwa Ancient City, Anuradhapura Sacred City, and Minneriya National Park (elephant gathering).
URL: https://www.chauffeuremillankatour.com/tours/cultural-triangle-5-days

### 3. Hill Country Journey — 4 Days / 3 Nights
Scenic tour through Sri Lanka's central highlands: Kandy (Temple of the Tooth), Nuwara Eliya tea plantations, Ella (Nine Arches Bridge, Little Adam's Peak), and Horton Plains.
URL: https://www.chauffeuremillankatour.com/tours/hill-country-4-days

### 4. Beach Paradise — 8 Days / 7 Nights
Coastal tour covering Colombo, the Galle Fort (Dutch colonial heritage), Mirissa whale watching and beaches, and the southern coast.
URL: https://www.chauffeuremillankatour.com/tours/beach-paradise-8-days

### 5. Complete Sri Lanka — 14 Days / 13 Nights
Comprehensive island-wide tour combining wildlife, culture, hill country, and beaches. Ideal for first-time visitors who want to experience everything Sri Lanka has to offer.
URL: https://www.chauffeuremillankatour.com/tours/complete-sri-lanka-14-days

### 6. Signature Experience Circuit
Emil's flagship luxury tour combining the best highlights across all regions with premium accommodation and exclusive experiences.
URL: https://www.chauffeuremillankatour.com/tours/signature-experience-circuit

### 7. Southern Sun & Cultural Odyssey — 20 Days / 19 Nights
The most comprehensive Sri Lanka tour available: wildlife, culture, hill country, beaches, and off-the-beaten-path destinations. Best for travellers with ample time.
URL: https://www.chauffeuremillankatour.com/tours/southern-sun-cultural-odyssey-20-days

### Custom / Tailor-Made Tours
Any duration, any route, any budget. Emil will design a fully personalised itinerary.
URL: https://www.chauffeuremillankatour.com/tailor-made

## Best Time to Visit Sri Lanka

- South & West coast (Colombo, Galle, Mirissa): December to March
- East coast (Trincomalee, Arugam Bay): June to September
- Cultural Triangle & Hill Country: accessible year-round
- Yala leopard safari: best February to July
- Minneriya elephant gathering: August to October
